open_items: SBS provider_down continuously from cycle 1107 (2026-10-25T10:01Z) through cycle 1120 (2026-10-26T12:01Z): 14 consecutive cycles, 26 hours, no recovery. The 24h escalation checkpoint the previous run set (around cycle 1119) has now passed. Reported as an ALERT this run: this is a human-decision item now, not a watch-and-see one. Re-check next run; if SBS recovers, report recovery; if it continues, this stays open without re-alerting every cycle unless the situation changes materially (e.g. crosses 48h, or the failure shape changes).
